steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; __rhf.god(true); g.env.setTime(12); g.env.timeScale=0; const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=0.2; we.cloudTarget=0.2; we.rain=0; we.rainTarget=0; we.timer=9999; const p=g.world.place('pier'); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,p.face||0); g.player.tool='rod'; g.viewmodel.setTool('rod'); g.state.coolerCapOverride=99; window.__until=async(fn,ms=240000)=>{const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ const r=fn(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,200)); } return null;}; window.__land=async(species,weight)=>{ const f=g.fishing; f.cancel(); f.fight={fish:{species,weight,legend:null}}; f.finishCatch(); await __until(()=>!document.getElementById('catch').hidden,30000); await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,3500)); const badges=[...document.querySelectorAll('#catch-badges span')].map(b=>b.textContent).join(' '); return species+': '+document.getElementById('catch-name').textContent+' | '+badges+' | '+document.getElementById('catch-weight').textContent+', '+document.getElementById('catch-length').textContent+', '+document.getElementById('catch-value').textContent; }; window.__release=async()=>{ document.getElementById('catch-release').click(); await __until(()=>document.getElementById('catch').hidden,20000); return 'released'; }; return 'at the pier'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; for(const id of Object.keys(g.state.journal)) {} const ids=['pink','sockeye','coho','king','chum','rainbow','dolly','grayling','char','laker','pike','burbot','halibut','lingcod','yelloweye','cod']; for(const id of ids) g.state.journal[id]=g.state.journal[id]||{count:1,best:1,bestLen:30}; g.screens.tab='fish'; g.screens.open('journal'); await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,3000)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sheet-body .fishcard').length; const tiers=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sheet-body .fishcard .tier')].map(t=>t.textContent); const c={}; for(const t of tiers) c[t]=(c[t]||0)+1; return 'journal cards '+n+', tiers '+JSON.stringify(c)+', tab '+document.querySelector('#sheet-tabs .on, #sheet-tabs [aria-selected=true]')?.textContent})()
(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const b=document.getElementById('sheet-body'); b.scrollTop=b.scrollHeight; await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,1500)); return 'scrolled'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.screens.close(); g.state.gear.lures=['spinner','fly','bead','dryfly','bugger','popper','hoochie','swimbait','squid']; g.screens.open('lure'); await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,2500)); return 'tackle box: '+[...document.querySelectorAll('#sheet-body .item h4')].map(h=>h.textContent).join(', ')})()
